RIDE PROFILE is downstream projection calibration, not analysis truth
text sync offset must not modify stored timed-text cue addresses or promote unaligned text to aligned
ride-profile storage keys must use the same source identity key used by LIVE when an exact hash exists
phone ADDRESS/APERTURE arbitration changes projection control only; it must not alter the closed BEAT/PHRASE/SECTION/TRACK aperture vocabulary
exact-hash LISTEN→LIVE vault handoff is browser-local convenience, not cloud storage or transferred source authority
